text: {"schema_version":1,"verdict":"revise","checked":["intent_match","tradeoff_direction","knob_legality"],"critique":"Intent says “flag attacks immediately even if you are sometimes wrong” (early, tolerate false alarms). Policy uses early_attack_detection settings (window=3, threshold_q=0.9, persistence=1) which is directionally right. However, knob_legality is unclear: menu requires threshold_q in {0.9,0.95,0.99,0.995,0.999,0.9999,\"default\"} and persistence in {1,2,3,5}; these are legal, but policy includes non-menu fields (action/policy wrapper) not checked. Revise to present only menu knobs."}
